title: You find a $4 million lottery ticket on the bus

segments.text: You find a lottery ticket on the bus floor.
You check the numbers. Out of habit.
Four million dollars. And nobody saw you pick it up.
Then you remember the woman who got off one stop ago. Searching her pockets.
A name. A phone number. She signed it.
In many places, a signed ticket can only be claimed by the person who signed it.
Do you call her, or try your luck?
